user.title: Connect to your ArtiLED Hub
user.description: Enter the Hub's IP address or hostname, and the username and password you use to sign in to the Hub.

data_description.create_dashboard: Adds an ArtiLED page to the sidebar that builds itself from the Hub. Created once; if you delete it later it stays deleted (Configure can put it back).

reauth_confirm.title: ArtiLED Hub sign-in no longer works
reauth_confirm.description: The Hub at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Sign in again with your Hub username and password. Your rooms, zones, names and voice settings are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Hub. Check the host and network.
error.invalid_auth: The Hub did not accept that username or password.

abort.reauth_failed: That configuration entry no longer exists.
abort.wrong_hub: Those credentials belong to a different ArtiLED Hub. Sign in to the Hub already configured here, or add the other Hub as a new integration.
